- Unlock protected margins, deal support, and joint GTM execution across markets.

### Product and Program Partnerships

Bundle Sentry continuous testing into your platform to surface realistic risk signals and strengthen customer trust.

- Co-deliver products, integrations, and platform reviews.
- Route validated findings directly into your product, roadmap, and SOC workflows.
- Launch joint services with marketing support and partner ready content.

### Value Added Resellers and Managed Service Providers

- Offer your clients advanced assessment programs, operator led monitoring, and attack simulation services.
- Deliver engagements under your brand with Sentry operators acting as an extension of your team.
